date_inferred_from: No heading of a sitting is on the page. The entry stands on leaf 266 verso, between the sitting of 5 September 1776 (leaf 201 verso) and October 1777 (leaf 335 verso); the book fills about ten leaves a month, which puts it in the first months of 1777.

translation.en:
Right Honourable Prusimski against Right Honourable Chełmski — Protest Lodged

Since the Information has not been provided in response to the Requisition of the party within the expired three-day period, the matter is thereby restricted.

Antoni of Kolno Prusimski, Starost of Niszczewice — by his own hand.

summary_en: The heading of a protest by Prusimski against Chełmski, undated, probably of 1777. Under it the clerk notes that the information for it was not supplied and that, at the party's request and three days having passed, it "is limited". Antoni Prusimski of Kolno, Starost of Niszczewice, signed.
summary_de: Überschrift eines Protests von Prusimski gegen Chełmski, ohne Datum, wohl 1777. Darunter vermerkt der Schreiber, dass die Angaben dazu nicht geliefert wurden und dass auf Verlangen der Partei nach Ablauf von drei Tagen „limitiert“ wird. Antoni Prusimski von Kolno, Starost von Niszczewice, hat unterschrieben.
